candidate_release_binding.candidate_isolation: Each candidate has a distinct write-once artifact directory, packet id, authority policy, release, raw observations, and result.
candidate_release_binding.compiler_input: Canonical candidate JSON has exactly schema, candidate_id, and parameters; its SHA256 and the exact canonical template SHA256 bind compilation.
candidate_release_binding.independent_verification: The verifier recomputes all 69 claims from the four compiler outputs before issuing authority claims, adjudication, per-candidate policy, sealed packet, and candidate release.
candidate_release_binding.one_to_one_mapping: Every searched template leaf consumes one unique candidate key and every candidate key is consumed exactly once.
candidate_release_binding.runner_binding: The runner request must bind the exact candidate release, sealed packet, and authority policy paths and SHA256 values; candidate_id or path matching alone is prohibited.

parameter_authority.fixed_leaf_rule: A fixed unknown, transferred value, initialization, geometry value, reversal, or Q10 remains model_prior/model_source unless an exact primary-source measurement is separately claimed and bound.

fixed_model_prior_boundaries.calcium_sk: Current fraction, geometry, constant calcium reversal, and every fixed calcium/SK Q10 or reference temperature are model priors. Geometry and current fraction require the filed held-out sensitivities because intact fitting cannot identify them separately.
fixed_model_prior_boundaries.channel_kinetics: Fixed Phillips-form NaP/Cav2.2 values and unresolved HCN kinetics are model-source priors even where transferred experiments support a mechanism direction.
fixed_model_prior_boundaries.fast_hh: The classic HH equation family, initialization, detection threshold, capacitance, and all three Q10 values are model assumptions; they are not adult-SNr measurements. Potassium density is searched because no fixed adult-SNr authority exists.
fixed_model_prior_boundaries.ionic_environment: The fixed extracellular calcium, valence, and simulation temperature define the readiness model condition and do not authorize an inferred intracellular density.
fixed_model_prior_boundaries.q10: No located source measured SNr fast-Na, Kv3, NaP, Cav2.2, HCN, calcium-state, or SK Q10; the fixed neutral Q10 values prevent an invented temperature correction.

calcium_baseline.basis: range across published model priors; native adult-SNr free calcium unresolved

calcium_decay_tau.basis: range across Johnson-McIntyre, Thompson/Snudda, and Phillips model priors

cav22_conductance_density.basis: published SNr and GPi/EP model envelope; pharmacology establishes channel role, not density

fast_hh_leak_conductance_density.basis: published SNr model-centered passive-leak envelope; adult passive cohort excluded

fast_hh_potassium_conductance_density.basis: 2-8 mS/cm2 published GPi/EP Kv3-like model envelope used only as a project search bound; juvenile SNr data report composite current and kinetics rather than an adult conductance density, and the executable classic-HH gate is not Kv3-specific

fast_hh_sodium_conductance_density.basis: juvenile-rat somatic measurement to published SNr model envelope; project search decision, not adult density

hcn_conductance_density.basis: baseline search envelope constrained by weak baseline lesion effect

nalcn_conductance_density.basis: project envelope constrained by lesion function; no source reports adult NALCN density

nalcn_reversal.basis: filed functional search envelope; no adult matched reversal measurement

nap_activation_half.basis: Phillips model center with Ding/Atherton transferred activation context

nap_activation_slope.basis: Phillips model center with Ding/Atherton transferred activation context

nap_conductance_density.basis: published SNr model/search envelope; lesion establishes necessity, not density

nap_inactivation_half.basis: Phillips model center plus transferred juvenile-rat envelope

nap_inactivation_slope.basis: Phillips model center plus transferred juvenile-rat envelope; sign follows executable equation

nap_inactivation_tau_max.basis: filed model/search interval; exact native adult-SNr kinetics unresolved

potassium_reversal.basis: published model envelope; not an adult matched measurement

sk_activation_tau.basis: recombinant SK2 transfer and published model-prior envelope

sk_conductance_density.basis: published model-centered envelope constrained by apamin lesion direction; not adult density

sk_deactivation_tau.basis: recombinant SK2 transferred mean plus or minus reported spread; not native adult-SNr kinetics

sk_half_activation.basis: recombinant SK2 transfer interval around 0.62 uM; native adult-SNr affinity unresolved

sk_hill_coefficient.basis: recombinant SK2 transfer and Thompson/Snudda model envelope

sodium_reversal.basis: juvenile-rat measured center within filed transfer envelope

readiness_only_execution.deterministic_engine_initialization: A disclosed constant is permitted only when stochastic runtime features are disabled; it is not a scientific partition seed.

fast_potassium.decision: search density within 2-8 mS/cm2 rather than fix 4 mS/cm2
fast_potassium.held_out_requirement: survivors must preserve spike repolarization, autonomous firing, SK/Cav2.2 lesion signs, and depolarization-block controls under a separately sealed fast-potassium equation sensitivity before any Kv3-like interpretation
fast_potassium.identifiability: density is identifiable only jointly with sodium, leak, SK, waveform, depolarization-block, and lesion gates; rate alone is insufficient
fast_potassium.model_boundary: the executable current retains classic-HH n-gate kinetics and is not validated as a Kv3-specific current
fast_potassium.source_boundary: the 2-8 mS/cm2 interval is a transferred published-model envelope and the fitted value is not an adult-SNr or juvenile-SNr density

geometry_current_fraction.current_fraction_boundary: current_fraction is fixed at the transparent physical maximum; changing it separately from accessible volume would duplicate the same effective calcium-coupling degree of freedom, so it is not an additional search coordinate
geometry_current_fraction.decision: keep membrane_area=2000 um2, accessible_calcium_volume=200 um3, and current_fraction=1 as one primary model-prior coordinate system rather than search three confounded leaves

held_out_sensitivities.effect: 0.5x primary calcium influx conversion; must be trace-equivalent to source-model-shell-depth-0p2um before rounding tolerance
preserves calcium conversion while doubling a fixed-nS inhibitory input's current density
preserves calcium conversion while halving a fixed-nS inhibitory input's current density

geometry_current_fraction.identifiability: calcium influx depends on current_fraction times membrane_area divided by accessible_calcium_volume, so intact calcium and SK traces cannot identify the three values independently; membrane area also scales conductance-clamp current density
geometry_current_fraction.pass_condition: the two 0.5x calcium-conversion arms are trace-equivalent within filed numerical tolerance; all distinct sensitivity arms preserve Cav2.2 and SK causal directions, avoid rate-only rescue and new depolarization block, and retain the required inhibition/release signs; no arm identifies native adult geometry or buffering

scientific_boundaries.hcn_baseline: the filed 20 percent operational margin is not a source equivalence interval
scientific_boundaries.held_out_calcium_reversal: dynamic Nernst E_Ca must preserve Cav2.2 and SK causal signs without extreme-reversal rate rescue or new depolarization block
scientific_boundaries.primary_calcium_reversal: constant packet E_Ca is a model prior for the primary campaign
scientific_boundaries.successful_fit: supports a viable mechanism family only; it does not measure unresolved channel densities, geometry, calcium coupling, native kinetics, or Q10

transition_to_executable: Requires all missing real runner and scorer contracts, the fast-potassium equation sensitivity, geometry and effective-calcium-coupling held-out sensitivities, all source/hash/integrity gates, and the seed-free two-candidate real-model dry run to pass before a separately reviewed status change.
